maria: Quick brain-dump 
Who9s around this weekend? Thinking: (A) mini DIY bike clinic + coffee at noon, (B) neighborhood brunch crawl at 11, or (C) low-key backyard hang with backyard firepit if it9s dry. I can host the firepit if someone brings marshmallows.

alex: Bike clinic sounds great 6B2 I9m down to bring a multitool and some spare tubes. Also can swing brunch if people prefer pancakes.

jamie: Backyard hang for me if it9s dry. I9ll bring a deck of cards and a bluetooth speaker. Also happy to help with minor bike tuning.

noah: Brunch crawl tempts me but I9m on call Saturday morning. If I9m free after noon I9ll swing by the backyard. Otherwise vote bikes.

sophia: I9m allergic to smoke so I9d prefer brunch or bike clinic. If backyard, I9ll sit a safe distance away and bring my own snacks. :avocado:

maria: Good call @sophia 9F895A Plan: check rain forecast 8am Sunday. If sunny -> backyard hang 5pm. If cloudy/wet -> Bike clinic at @central-cafe at noon. Brunch crawl stays an iffy option depending on numbers. I9ll post final at 9am Sunday.

opsbot: Heads up: maintenance window Sunday 03:00-04:00 may affect calendar notifications. No impact to events.

alex: RSVP: Bike clinic if raining, backyard if dry. I9ll bring spare tubes and coffee.

jamie: RSVP yes 44D I9ll bring cards + speaker. DM the address when final.

noah: RSVP maybe 937 I9ll confirm when I9m off call.

sophia: RSVP brunch or bike. No firepits for me but I9ll be happy to help set up blankets and non-smoky snacks.

maria: Thanks all 64F I9ll shout with the final plan Sunday 9am. Marshmallows volunteers? :camping:
